facts.activity_file: removing isolation and returning to operations

control_failures.control_label: controlled removal of isolation and return to service
parking, chocking and restraint of equipment

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: hazard report - electrical exposure at P-9503

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the controlled removal of isolation and return to service on P-9503 and M-9503 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically removing isolation and returning to operations. P-9503 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during routine operation while the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was not in place. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 30 May 2015 a hazard report was recorded on P-9503 and M-9503 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during routine operation; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
